title: Temma and NexStar motion deadline branches have no regression
summary: FND-20261023101753-bc8d-complete-repository-audit-024 added TEMMA_SLEW_TIMEOUT (600 s, GOTO and park, indigo_mount_temma.driver) and NEXSTAR_PARK_TIMEOUT (300 s, indigo_mount_nexstar.driver) without a test, because the simulators cannot shorten the deadline. Next: add an #ifndef override used by the test build (as wheel_asi/wheel_playerone do) and cover expiry, stop and ALERT.
